crossRefs.note: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then…
The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.

people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

people.name: Simeon
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, one of the twelve tribes.

translations.web: “By the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side, Issachar, one portion.
translations.bsb: Issachar will have one portion bordering the territory of Simeon from east to west.
